settings.title: What’s included
settings.content:
• Two matching magnetic connection bracelets — one for you and one for your person.
  • Adjustable sliding cords.
  • One gift box, ready to give.

settings.title: How the connection works
settings.content: Wear one bracelet each while you are apart. When you are together, bring the charms close and the magnets pull into place — a small ritual that makes the two halves feel whole again.

settings.title: Fit & care
settings.content: Use the sliding cords to adjust each bracelet. Keep the bracelets dry and remove them before bathing, swimming, or exercising. Wipe the charms gently with a soft, dry cloth after wear.

settings.title: Is this set personalized?
settings.content: No. This matching set arrives ready to share, with no engraving or personalization required.
